carbon-ink.$description: Carbon Ink — Primary text, filled action buttons, icon strokes, hairlines — the dominant ink across the entire interface

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark fills, image backgrounds

soft-mist.$description: Soft Mist — Subtle surface alternation, disabled states, skeleton backgrounds, light dividers

warm-fog.$description: Warm Fog — Off-white surface variant for subtle banding between product rows and editorial sections

blush-sand.$description: Blush Sand — Warm cream surface for editorial highlight sections and seasonal accents

smoke-charcoal.$description: Smoke Charcoal — Secondary text, input borders, subdued UI chrome

onyx.$description: Onyx — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

stone-gray.$description: Stone Gray — Placeholder backgrounds, image placeholder fills, neutral swatch defaults

slate.$description: Slate — Cool charcoal for product photography backgrounds and muted editorial surfaces

olive-drab.$description: Olive Drab — Warm muted surface for product photography contexts

maroon-clay.$description: Maroon Clay — Warm muted surface for product photography contexts

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Cool muted surface for product photography contexts

pewter.$description: Pewter — Cool gray for product photography contexts

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Warm beige for product photography contexts

pale-tide.$description: Pale Tide — Cool pastel surface for editorial accent sections

favorit.$description: Brand and UI typeface — used across all navigation, headings, body, buttons, inputs, and product cards. Custom monoline sans-serif with tight tracking (0.025em). Substitutes: Inter, Söhne, or Neue Haas Grotesk. The whisper-weight 400 at 30px for hero headlines is a signature choice — most fashion sites use display serifs or bold weights, but Adanola's regular-weight headlines in a clean sans feel like editorial captions rather than advertising slogans.

nunito-sans.$description: Secondary fallback for form inputs and minor chrome elements

arial.$description: System fallback for legacy email and content blocks

swym-font.$description: swym-font — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

source-sans-pro.$description: Source Sans Pro — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
